title: Hephaistos Markers
description: Marker blocks for planning builds and terraforming.
body:
# Hephaistos Markers 🎨

Hephaistos Markers adds a full set of bright, high-visibility planning blocks made for builders, terraformers, and map designers. Perfect for marking areas, outlining builds, planning terrain changes, or organizing large projects. All blocks glow, are easy to spot from afar, and come in a clean unified palette. ⚡🧱
